newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MBf says to buy into Philippine bank.
newsitem.headline: MBf says to buy into Philippine bank.

text.p: Malaysia's MBf Holdings Bhd said on Friday it has agreed to buy 60 percent of Philippines' Prime Savings Bank (PSB).
The financial services and property group said in a statement that the subscription price will be 465 million pesos.
PSB is a thrift bank with 51 branches in the country.
MBf said the acquisition would boost its plans to provide financial services in the Philippines.
The company already has investments in the country through RFC Inc and Unitrust Development Bank.
The group plans to launch its credit card business in the Philippines through a subsidiary of RFC, MBf Card Inc (MCI).
"MCI could tap on the large branch network and customer base of PSB for its credit card operations in the Philippines.
MBf said the acquisition is subject to the signing of a formal agreement and due diligence, after getting approvals from Malaysian and Philippine regulatory authorities.
MBf holds a 31.52 percent equity interest in MBf Capital Bhd, which owns Malaysia's largest finance company.
